dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Here, I got you your flower.

dialogues.speaker: Finch
dialogues.text: Pretty flower, thank you! I'm off! I'm off!

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Are you sure you're able to hold on to it? What if the metal flower falls out from your beak while you're flying up there...?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's already gone. May they both find their way home safely.
